```{r}
rm(list=ls())
set.seed(123)

all_sea_data <- read_csv(here("~/Documents/yodalab/paper/JAB/data/not_for_upload/data_for_stan.csv"))

add_day_night_column <- function(df) {
  # UTC→JST
  df$time <- with_tz(df$time, "Japan")
  # POSIXct→Date
  date_only <- as.Date(df$time)

  # Calculate sunset sunrise
  sun_data <- data.frame(date = date_only, lat = df$lat, lon = df$lon)
  sun_times <- getSunlightTimes(data = sun_data, keep = c("sunrise", "sunset"))
  sun_times$sunrise <- with_tz(sun_times$sunrise, "Japan")
  sun_times$sunset <- with_tz(sun_times$sunset, "Japan")
  df$day_night <- mapply(function(time, sunrise, sunset) {
    hour_time <- format(time, "%H:%M:%S")
    hour_sunrise <- format(sunrise, "%H:%M:%S")
    hour_sunset <- format(sunset, "%H:%M:%S")
    if (hour_time >= hour_sunrise & hour_time <= hour_sunset) {
      return("Day")
    } else {
      return("Night")
    }
  }, df$time, sun_times$sunrise, sun_times$sunset)

  return(df)
}

all_sea_data <- add_day_night_column(all_sea_data)
all_sea_data$day_night <- ifelse(all_sea_data$day_night == "Day", 1, 0)

# UTC→JST
all_sea_data$time <- with_tz(all_sea_data$time, "Japan")
# NA removal
all_sea_data <- all_sea_data[!is.na(all_sea_data$age) &
                               !is.na(all_sea_data$α) &
                               !is.na(all_sea_data$wind_cross), ]
all_sea_data <- all_sea_data  %>% mutate(foot_year = paste(foot,year,sep="_"))
```

# make the dataframe to give stan
```{r}
all_sea_data <- all_sea_data[!is.na(all_sea_data$age) & 
                             !is.na(all_sea_data$α) & 
                             !is.na(all_sea_data$wind_cross), ]

all_sea_data$Nest_Distance <- as.vector(scale(all_sea_data$Nest_Distance))
all_sea_data$age <- all_sea_data$age - min(all_sea_data$age) + 1

all_sea_data <- all_sea_data %>%
  mutate(year_foot = paste(year, foot, sep = "_"))

# 1. Age_ID[N_Bird]: Age corresponding to each individual (year_foot)
unique_bird_age <- all_sea_data %>%
  dplyr::select(year_foot, age) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(year_foot)

Age_ID <- unique_bird_age$age

# 2. Bird_ID[N_Trip]: Individual ID corresponding to each trip
unique_trip_bird <- all_sea_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, year_foot) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(ID) %>% 
  left_join(unique_bird_age %>% mutate(bird_index = row_number()), by = "year_foot")

Bird_ID <- unique_trip_bird$bird_index

# 3. Trip_ID[N]: Trip ID corresponding to each observation
Trip_ID <- as.integer(as.factor(all_sea_data$ID))

# data_list_sea
data_list_sea <- list(
  N = nrow(all_sea_data),
  N_Age = max(all_sea_data$age),
  N_Bird = length(unique(all_sea_data$year_foot)),
  N_Trip = length(unique(all_sea_data$ID)),  
  alpha = as.vector(all_sea_data$α),
  Nest_Distance = as.vector(all_sea_data$Nest_Distance),
  wind_cross = as.vector(all_sea_data$wind_cross),
  Age_ID = Age_ID,    
  Bird_ID = Bird_ID,  
  Trip_ID = Trip_ID,  
  day_night = as.vector(all_sea_data$day_night)
)
```

#model
```{r}
set.seed(1235)
options(timeout = 1000000)

model <- "
data {
  int<lower=0> N;  // Total number of data points
  int<lower=1> N_Age;// Range of ages in the data: (max age) - (min age) + 1
  int<lower=1> N_Bird;  // Total number of individual IDs
  int<lower=1> N_Trip;  // Total number of trip IDs
  vector[N] alpha;  // Response variable (instantaneous deflection)
  vector[N] Nest_Distance;  // Distance from the nest
  vector[N] wind_cross;  // Crosswind component
  int<lower=1,upper=N_Age> Age_ID[N_Bird];  // Age for each individual
  int<lower=1,upper=N_Bird> Bird_ID[N_Trip];  // Individual ID for each trip
  int<lower=1,upper=N_Trip> Trip_ID[N];  // Trip ID for each observation
  vector[N] day_night; // Light condition (day/night)

}

parameters {
  vector[N_Age] a;// Slope for each age
  vector[N_Bird] a_Bird;  // Individual-level slope
  vector[N_Trip] a_Trip;  // Trip-level slope
  vector[N_Trip] d_Trip;  // Trip-level intercept
  real c;  // Coefficient for the linear term
  real c2; // Coefficient for the quadratic term
  real e; // Parameter representing the effect of day/night
  real<lower=0> s_a[N_Age];  // Variance of a_Bird (individual-level slope variance)
  real<lower=0> s_a_Trip[N_Age];  // Variance of a_Trip (trip-level slope variance)
  real<lower=0> s_d;  // Variance of d_Trip (trip-level intercept variance)
  real<lower=0> c_a;  // Strength of age correlation in a
  real<lower=0> c_s_a;  // Strength of age correlation in s_a
  real<lower=0> c_s_a_Trip;  // Strength of age correlation in s_a_Trip
  real<lower=0> s_obs;  // Observation error of alpha
}

model {
  // Age correlation in a and s_a
        a[2:N_Age] ~ normal(a[1:(N_Age-1)],c_a);
      s_a[2:N_Age] ~ normal(s_a[1:(N_Age-1)],c_s_a);
 s_a_Trip[2:N_Age] ~ normal(s_a_Trip[1:(N_Age-1)],c_s_a_Trip);
  // Priors for individual-level parameters
  for(k in 1:N_Bird){  
  a_Bird[k] ~ normal(a[Age_ID[k]], s_a[Age_ID[k]]);
  }
  
  // Priors for trip-level parameters
  for(k in 1:N_Trip){
  a_Trip[k] ~ normal(a_Bird[Bird_ID[k]], s_a_Trip[Age_ID[Bird_ID[k]]]);  // Ringに基づいて個体レベルの傾きを参照
  }
  d_Trip ~ normal(0, s_d);  // Reference individual-level slope based on Bird_ID

  // Model
  for (n in 1:N) {
    alpha[n] ~ normal((a_Trip[Trip_ID[n]] + c * Nest_Distance[n] + c2 * pow(Nest_Distance[n], 2) + e * day_night[n]) * wind_cross[n] + d_Trip[Trip_ID[n]], s_obs);
  }
}

generated quantities {
  vector[N] log_lik;
  for (n in 1:N) {
    log_lik[n] = normal_lpdf(alpha[n] | (a_Trip[Trip_ID[n]] + c * Nest_Distance[n] + c2 * pow(Nest_Distance[n], 2) + e * day_night[n]) * wind_cross[n] + d_Trip[Trip_ID[n]], s_obs);
  }
}
"
# Extend the socket timeout to prevent disconnection during long sampling
options(timeout = 100000)

# fit_dist <- stan(

#   iter = 11000,

out_dir <- "~/Documents/yodalab/paper/JAB/data/not_for_upload/Stan/"

dir.create(

# Run Chain 1
fit1 <- stan(

    max_treedepth = 15,

saveRDS(

# Run Chain 2

  )

saveRDS(
  fit2,
  paste0(out_dir, "fit2.rds")
)

# Run Chain 3
fit3 <- stan(
  model_code = model,
  data = data_list_sea,
  iter = 11000,
  warmup = 1000,
  chains = 1,
  chain_id = 3,
  control = list(
    max_treedepth = 15,
    adapt_delta = 0.99
  )
)

saveRDS(
  fit3,
  paste0(out_dir, "fit3.rds")
)

# Run Chain 4
fit4 <- stan(
  model_code = model,
  data = data_list_sea,
  iter = 11000,
  warmup = 1000,
  chains = 1,
  chain_id = 4,
  control = list(
    max_treedepth = 15,
    adapt_delta = 0.99
  )
)

saveRDS(
  fit4,
  paste0(out_dir, "fit4.rds")
)

# Combine chains
fit_dist <- sflist2stanfit(
  list(fit1, fit2, fit3, fit4)
)

saveRDS(
  fit_dist,
  paste0(out_dir, "StanResult_dist_forpaper.rds")
)
```

#Figure4
Environmental effects included (day = 1, distance = median)
```{r}
#fit <- readRDS(here("~/Documents/yodalab/paper/JAB/data/not_for_upload/Stan/StanResult_dist_forpaper.rds"))
#fit <- readRDS(here("~/Documents/yodalab/paper/JAB/data/StanResult_dist_forpaper.rds"))

all_sea_data <- read_csv(here("~/Documents/yodalab/paper/JAB/data/final_data_for_stan.csv"))
all_sea_data <- all_sea_data %>%
  mutate(year_foot = paste(year, foot, sep = "_"))

if(abs(mean(all_sea_data$Nest_Distance, na.rm = TRUE)) > 1000) {
  all_sea_data$Nest_Distance <- as.vector(scale(all_sea_data$Nest_Distance))
}

extract_params_with_env <- function(fit, param_name) {
  param <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = param_name)[[param_name]]
  mean_param <- apply(param, 2, mean)
  lower_ci_95 <- apply(param, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025)
  upper_ci_95 <- apply(param, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)
  lower_ci_75 <- apply(param, 2, quantile, probs = 0.125)
  upper_ci_75 <- apply(param, 2, quantile, probs = 0.875)
  
  data.frame(
    mean = mean_param, 
    lower_ci_95 = lower_ci_95, 
    upper_ci_95 = upper_ci_95,
    lower_ci_75 = lower_ci_75, 
    upper_ci_75 = upper_ci_75
  )
}

a_post <- extract_params_with_env(fit, "a")
s_a_post <- extract_params_with_env(fit, "s_a")
s_a_Trip_post <- extract_params_with_env(fit, "s_a_Trip")

c_params <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = "c")$c
c2_params <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = "c2")$c2
e_params <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = "e")$e

c_mean <- mean(c_params)
c2_mean <- mean(c2_params)
e_mean <- mean(e_params)

nest_distance_median <- median(all_sea_data$Nest_Distance, na.rm = TRUE)
day_night_value <- 1  # Day

environmental_effect <- c_mean * nest_distance_median + 
                       c2_mean * nest_distance_median^2 + 
                       e_mean * day_night_value

unique_age_mapping <- all_sea_data %>%
  dplyr::select(year_foot, age) %>%
  distinct() 

df_age <- data.frame(Age = unique_age_mapping$age)
min_age <- min(df_age$Age)
max_age <- max(df_age$Age)

data_a_age_only <- tibble(
  Age = min_age:max_age,
  Mean = a_post$mean,
  LowerCI95 = a_post$lower_ci_95,
  UpperCI95 = a_post$upper_ci_95,
  LowerCI75 = a_post$lower_ci_75,
  UpperCI75 = a_post$upper_ci_75,
  Type = "Age effect only"
)

data_a_with_env <- tibble(
  Age = min_age:max_age,
  Mean = a_post$mean + environmental_effect,
  LowerCI95 = a_post$lower_ci_95 + environmental_effect,
  UpperCI95 = a_post$upper_ci_95 + environmental_effect,
  LowerCI75 = a_post$lower_ci_75 + environmental_effect,
  UpperCI75 = a_post$upper_ci_75 + environmental_effect,
  Type = "With environmental effects"
)

data_a_comparison <- rbind(data_a_age_only, data_a_with_env)

data_s_a <- tibble(
  Age = min_age:max_age,
  Mean = s_a_post$mean,
  LowerCI95 = s_a_post$lower_ci_95,
  UpperCI95 = s_a_post$upper_ci_95,
  LowerCI75 = s_a_post$lower_ci_75,
  UpperCI75 = s_a_post$upper_ci_75,
  var = rep("SD_among_Ind", nrow(s_a_post))
)

data_s_a_Trip <- tibble(
  Age = min_age:max_age,
  Mean = s_a_Trip_post$mean,
  LowerCI95 = s_a_Trip_post$lower_ci_95,
  UpperCI95 = s_a_Trip_post$upper_ci_95,
  LowerCI75 = s_a_Trip_post$lower_ci_75,
  UpperCI75 = s_a_Trip_post$upper_ci_75,
  var = rep("SD_within_Ind", nrow(s_a_Trip_post))
)

plot_df <- rbind(data_s_a, data_s_a_Trip)

common_theme <- theme_bw(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "cm"),
    text = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24)
  )

x_min <- min(df_age$Age) - 0.5
x_max <- max(df_age$Age) + 0.5

common_x_axis <- scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(x_min, x_max),
  breaks = seq(ceiling(x_min), floor(x_max), by = 2),
  expand = c(0, 0)
)

p_h <- ggplot(df_age) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = Age), fill = "steelblue4", binwidth = 1) +
  common_x_axis +
  common_theme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  ylab("Individual number")

p_a_env <- ggplot(data_a_with_env, aes(x = Age, y = Mean)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LowerCI95, ymax = UpperCI95), alpha = 0.2, fill = "lightskyblue") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LowerCI75, ymax = UpperCI75), alpha = 0.4, fill = "steelblue") +
  common_x_axis +
  common_theme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  ylab("Degree of drift") 

p_s <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Age, y = Mean, group = var, color = var)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LowerCI95, ymax = UpperCI95, fill = var), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LowerCI75, ymax = UpperCI75, fill = var), alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SD_among_Ind" = "darkorange", "SD_within_Ind" = "yellowgreen")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SD_among_Ind" = "darkorange", "SD_within_Ind" = "yellowgreen")) +
  common_x_axis +
  common_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ylab("SD of degree of drift") +
  xlab("Age")

p_comb_env_only <- plot_grid(p_h, p_a_env, p_s, 
                             ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.4), align = "v")

ggsave(here("~/Documents/yodalab/paper/JAB/figure/Figure4_environmental_effects.png"), 
       plot = p_comb_env_only, width = 10, height = 16, dpi = 600)
```

#model with age 9 to 23
```{r}

model <- "
data {
  int<lower=0> N;  // Total number of data points
  int<lower=1> N_Age;// Range of ages in the data: (max age) - (min age) + 1
  int<lower=1> N_Bird;  // Total number of individual IDs
  int<lower=1> N_Trip;  // Total number of trip IDs
  vector[N] alpha;  // Response variable (instantaneous deflection)
  vector[N] Nest_Distance;  // Distance from the nest
  vector[N] wind_cross;  // Crosswind component
  int<lower=1,upper=N_Age> Age_ID[N_Bird];  // Age for each individual
  int<lower=1,upper=N_Bird> Bird_ID[N_Trip];  // Individual ID for each trip
  int<lower=1,upper=N_Trip> Trip_ID[N];  // Trip ID for each observation
  vector[N] day_night; // Light condition (day/night)

}

parameters {
  vector[N_Age] a;// Slope for each age
  vector[N_Bird] a_Bird;  // Individual-level slope
  vector[N_Trip] a_Trip;  // Trip-level slope
  vector[N_Trip] d_Trip;  // Trip-level intercept
  real c;  // Coefficient for the linear term
  real c2; // Coefficient for the quadratic term
  real e; // Parameter representing the effect of day/night
  real<lower=0> s_a[N_Age];  // Variance of a_Bird (individual-level slope variance)
  real<lower=0> s_a_Trip[N_Age];  // Variance of a_Trip (trip-level slope variance)
  real<lower=0> s_d;  // Variance of d_Trip (trip-level intercept variance)
  real<lower=0> c_a;  // Strength of age correlation in a
  real<lower=0> c_s_a;  // Strength of age correlation in s_a
  real<lower=0> c_s_a_Trip;  // Strength of age correlation in s_a_Trip
  real<lower=0> s_obs;  // Observation error of alpha
}

model {
  // Age correlation in a and s_a
        a[2:N_Age] ~ normal(a[1:(N_Age-1)],c_a);
      s_a[2:N_Age] ~ normal(s_a[1:(N_Age-1)],c_s_a);
 s_a_Trip[2:N_Age] ~ normal(s_a_Trip[1:(N_Age-1)],c_s_a_Trip);
  // Priors for individual-level parameters
  for(k in 1:N_Bird){  
  a_Bird[k] ~ normal(a[Age_ID[k]], s_a[Age_ID[k]]);
  }
  
  // Priors for trip-level parameters
  for(k in 1:N_Trip){
  a_Trip[k] ~ normal(a_Bird[Bird_ID[k]], s_a_Trip[Age_ID[Bird_ID[k]]]);  // Ringに基づいて個体レベルの傾きを参照
  }
  d_Trip ~ normal(0, s_d);  // Reference individual-level slope based on Bird_ID

  // Model
  for (n in 1:N) {
    alpha[n] ~ normal((a_Trip[Trip_ID[n]] + c * Nest_Distance[n] + c2 * pow(Nest_Distance[n], 2) + e * day_night[n]) * wind_cross[n] + d_Trip[Trip_ID[n]], s_obs);
  }
}

generated quantities {
  vector[N] log_lik;
  for (n in 1:N) {
    log_lik[n] = normal_lpdf(alpha[n] | (a_Trip[Trip_ID[n]] + c * Nest_Distance[n] + c2 * pow(Nest_Distance[n], 2) + e * day_night[n]) * wind_cross[n] + d_Trip[Trip_ID[n]], s_obs);
  }
}
"

# Extend the socket timeout to prevent disconnection during long sampling
options(timeout = 100000)

fit_dist <- stan(
  model_code = model, 
  data = data_list_sea, 
  iter = 11000, 
  warmup = 1000, 
  chains = 4, 
  control = list(
    max_treedepth = 15,
    adapt_delta = 0.99
  )
)

saveRDS(fit_dist,file=here("~/Documents/yodalab/paper/JAB/data/not_for_upload/Stan/StanResult_dist_forpaper.rds"))
```
